notes: Read all 129 source lines line by line before editing; preserved the exported VisuallyHiddenOwnProps, VisuallyHiddenProps, VisuallyHidden function, liveRegion, priority, focusable, children, as, and rest-prop API intent.

Tailwind sr-only and focus:not-sr-only are DOM/CSS-only, so the native output uses an absolutely positioned 1x1 opacity-0 Text/View primitive and documents domSrOnlyClassAvailable=false and focusRevealAvailable=false.

The web aria-live/role/aria-atomic live-region shorthand is mapped to React Native accessibilityLiveRegion plus alert/text/link roles where available; aria-atomic/htmlFor/href/className are accepted for parity but not forwarded to native primitives.

The default span and web as=label/as=a/as=div polymorphism were considered and mapped to Text or View without importing DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI components.
